reasons.persona_fit: Directly addresses a small business owner-operator in Bareni's calm, practical tone without hype, invented case studies, or unpermitted CTAs.
reasons.clarity: The core message is immediately clear, logically sequenced, and plainly explains how to categorise and evaluate deferred pilot work.
reasons.actionability: Provides a highly concrete, feasible three-column review method and clear decision threshold before rolling out a pilot into production.
reasons.factual_grounding: Makes no false claims regarding customers, tools, or performance metrics; appropriately framed as an operational evaluation method.
